# MicroDuck Monthly Team Learning Recruitment Copy

#### **04）MicroDuck**

- Open-source content: [MicroDuck Monthly Team Learning Recruitment](https://github.com/datawhalechina/every-embodied/blob/main/16-专题组队学习/05-MicroDuck运动策略与任务开发专题/月度组队学习招募文案.md)
- Course description: Using the interesting open-source duck MicroDuck as a medium, students will learn robot models, physical simulation, reinforcement learning, and motion control through 8 executable Notebooks. Starting with basketball balance, stilts, swinging, ball balance, and ladder climbing tasks, participants will experience GPU simulation and the deployment of Doughnut RDK X5 BPU, followed by integration with LightNav-0 visual language navigation. They will then understand the closed loop of embodied AI involving “observation, decision-making, action, and feedback” in different rooms. Each task lasts 2–3 days, including principle learning, code practice, and result sharing, totaling 21 days.
- Target participants: Learners with basic Python knowledge who want to get started in embodied AI, reinforcement learning, visual language navigation, or on-device deployment through specific robot tasks; students with experience in machine learning, robotics, or embedded systems are also welcome to participate in experiments and collaboration. Those without a physical duck or development board can still join the code and simulation learning.
- Number of learning groups: 2
- Number of participants per group: 180

**Task Schedule:**

Study from October 12, 2026, to November 1, 2026, for a total of 21 days. All times are in Beijing Time. The deadline for assignments is 03:00 the next day after the end of the learning date.

| Task Information | Days | Deadline | **Review** | **Excellent Assignment** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Officially starts on October 12 | 21 days in total | November 2, 03:00 | | |
| Task 1: Recognizing ducklings and basketball balance. Robot model, observation and motion, Actor-Critic and PPO | 3 days (October 12–14) | October 15, 03:00 | | |
| Task 2: Browser physical disturbance. MuJoCo contact, external force interaction and video recording | 2 days (October 15–16) | October 17, 03:00 | | |
| Task 3: Stilt walking. Support morphology, course learning, actuator and smooth motion | 3 days (October 17–19) | October 20, 03:00 | | |
| Task 4: Swinging rotation. Task reward, motion rhythm and policy reasoning | 2 days (October 20–21) | October 22, 03:00 | | |
| Task 5: Ball balance and FastSAC. Sampling, policy update, model export and simulation evaluation | 3 days (October 22–24) | October 25, 03:00 | | |
| Task 6: Climbing a ladder. Ramp contact, ladder climbing and dual policy switching | 3 days (October 25–27) | October 28, 03:00 | | |
| Task 7: RDK X5 and multi-policy deployment. ONNX, HBM, BPU inference and task scheduling | 3 days (October 28–30) | October 31, 03:00 | | |
| Task 8: LightNav-0 visual language navigation. GPU access to pre-trained models, multi-scenario experiments and result sharing | 2 days (October 31–November 1) | November 2, 03:00 | | |

Each task corresponds to a notebook. For the execution entry, see [. The notebook list is in ](03-Notebook/README.md). Navigation uses a pre-trained model; no navigation training or on-board deployment is required.

This document is a 21-day monthly team learning plan. The original [ 8-day short-term recruitment brochure ](recruitment-copy.md) and [ short-term learning plans ](learning-plan.md) are retained. Both plans share task tutorials and Notebooks. For task demonstrations, see [ Demonstration Overview ](01-task-information/selected-videos/README.md).
